text:
mia: FYI — ticket from AcmeCorp. Multiple 429s today with an error mentioning 'throttled: kv_cache_pressure' on our Dedicated pool-9. customer reports high-latency spikes when sending long contexts.

alice-cs: ticket: #C-2189. customer supplied request ids: req-01a2, req-01a3. they say some calls return 200 but with huge tail latency, others 429. sending example payload.

raj: looking at pool-9 logs now. seeing very high eviction churn: `kv_cache_evictions/sec ~ 340` and `kv_cache_entries ~ 480k` on many nodes. mem_frag_ratio creeping to 0.78.

sre-tilly: that frag ratio + large per-request KV allocations from long-context jobs can prevent allocator from handing out contiguous blocks, causing the runtime to trigger throttling as a safety. autoscaler didn't add nodes because per-node free_gpu_mem < autoscale_alloc_threshold.

jordan: repro steps I used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \\n  -d '{"model":"open-llm-xl","input":"'$(python gen_long_context.py 150000)'"}'
```
results in intermittent 429s with header `x-rw-throttle-reason: kv_cache_pressure` after sustained stream for ~6-8m.

mia: quick mitigation applied: reduced `kv_cache_max_entries` from 500000 -> 200000 on pool-9 nodes and rolled 2 of the busiest pods. immediate drop in eviction spikes but p95 latency still ~1.6-1.9s.

raj: also toggled `small-ctx-evict=true` on runtime to prefer evicting tiny prefixes aggressively for long-context streams. that reduced duplicate KV allocations. watch metrics: `kv_dup_allocs` down ~40% in last 10m.

alice-cs: routed traffic away from pool-9 to pool-12 for the customer's dedicated tag as temporary fallback. customer reports meaningful improvement in error rate.

deploy-bot: deploy job/kv-policy-update completed at 1762928580.

sre-tilly: longer-term items: 1) enable allocator compaction in next runtime release, 2) add per-tenant long-context rate limits in Dedicated config, 3) improve autoscaler to consider fragmentation metrics not just free memory. filing INFRA-789 with notes and perf traces.

mia: logging action items: raj + tilly to monitor pool-9 for 24h and confirm tail error rate < 0.1%. alice-cs to keep customer updated. :eyes:

alice-cs: customer says they can live with the reroute but want ETA on full fix. asked for weekly updates.

raj: collecting heap/dmesg dumps from two affected hosts and will attach to INFRA-789. if anyone wants repro logs I pushed them to /opt/support/attachments/C-2189/ on the support box.

mia: thanks everyone. if this recurs after compaction rollout we'll consider lowering default max_entries and adding a mem-frag alert.

jordan: note for runbook: under "Dedicated KV pressure" -> steps we took (reduce max_entries, enable small-ctx-evict, reroute to other pool, roll pods). will append exact commands.

alice-cs: marking ticket C-2189 as 'monitoring' and sending update to customer.
